jazzdisco 的 4100 系列頁：**BST-84134 年份欄印 1986**，編制「Johnny Coles, trumpet; Booker Ervin, tenor sax; Horace Parlan, piano; **Grant Green, guitar #1-5**; Butch Warren, bass; Billy Higgins, drums.」，地點 **Van Gelder Studio, Englewood Cliffs, NJ, 1963 年 2 月 15 日**，母帶順序 tk.6 Happy Frame Of Mind／tk.7 A Tune For Richard／tk.10 **Home In Africa**／tk.15 Dexi／tk.18 Back From The Gig／tk.21 Kucheza Blues。⚠ **Grant Green 只彈五軌，缺席的是母帶順序第六首 tk.21〈Kucheza Blues〉。**

jazzdisco 1963–1964 session 頁把同一場的發行欄逐軌列出：**六軌的發行欄全部是「Blue Note BN-LA488-H2, BST-84134」**，條尾三行「* Blue Note **BN-LA488-H2 Booker Ervin - Back From The Gig 1976**／* Blue Note BST-84134 Horace Parlan - Happy Frame Of Mind **1986**／= Blue Note CDP 7 84134 2 **1988**／= Mosaic MQ8-197, MD5-197 The Complete Blue Note Horace Parlan Sessions 2000」。**六軌全部早在 1976 年就以 Booker Ervin 名義的雙唱片出過（6/6），本盤是 1986 年第一次用 Parlan 的名字、用 1963 年編好的號與封面出版。**

**Cash Box 1986 年 8 月 9 日 p20「NOTES OF BLUE」專欄逐字**：「Blue Note has just dug back into its vaults for an odd set of reissues: **six items that were originally intended for release on the label in the ’60s, came out variously in the late-’70s (as parts of twofers, or in Japan only), and are now restored to the original look and concept that was scheduled in the ’60s.** Got it? Anyway, now available, and looking like vintage Blue Notes, are “Rollin’ With Leo”, Leo Parker; “Blue John”, Big John Patton; “Jubille Shout!!!”, Stanley Turrentine; “Dimensions & Extensions”, Sam Rivers; **“Happy Frame of Mind”, Horace Parlan**; and “Lush Life”…」——**廠牌自己把這一批定義成「復原 1960 年代原定的樣子」，不是「舊料重編」**（第 933 條的來源）。

**Cash Box 1986 年 6 月 14 日 p36 的檔期預告**（第 612 條的最硬一層）：「Blue Note, of course, holds down the jazz fort at the Capitol labels… **Mid-July will see the release of previously-unreleased sessions by Leo Parker, Stanley Turrentine, Horace Parlan, John Patton, Lou Donaldson, and Sam Rivers**, with an October set of reissues to include albums by Jimmy Smith, Grant Green, Ike Quebec, Duke Pearson, Lou Donaldson, Stanley Turrentine…」——**預告（6 月 14 日，說 7 月中）＋確認上市（8 月 9 日）兩則夾出 1986 年 7 月下旬的上市時點。**

Discogs 美國原壓 3163720（BST 84134，DMM）的 notes 逐字：「Recorded on February 15, 1963.／Direct Metal Mastering (DMM) Issue.／**This material was previously released in 1976 as part of [Back From the Gig], a double album under Booker Ervin's name. It is now issued here, for the first time, with the Cover Art and Catalogue Number, as originally intended by Blue Note in 1963.**」製作群：**Producer — Alfred Lion、錄音 Rudy Van Gelder、封面設計 Reid Miles、封面攝影 Francis Wolff**、**再發製作＋內頁文字 Michael Cuscuna**、數位轉錄 Ron McMaster。**盤面排序與母帶順序不同**：A1 Home Is Africa／A2 A Tune For Richard／A3 Back From The Gig／B1 Dexi／B2 Kucheza Blues／B3 Happy Frame Of Mind。

維基專頁 infobox：released 1986、recorded February 15, 1963、studio Van Gelder Studio、length **38:52**、label Blue Note BST 84134、producer Alfred Lion；本文逐字「performances recorded for Blue Note in 1963, **but not released under Parlan's name on the label until 1986**. The session was originally released under Booker Ervin's name in 1976 as part of the Blue Note 2-LP set *Back from the Gig* and later released as originally intended.」⚠ **維基說「The album was first released on a CD in 1995」與 MB 不符**——MB 有 **1988 年的 US CD e1fa2d0e（077778413424）**，jazzdisco 也記 CDP 7 84134 2＝1988。**正文不得採用維基的 1995。**
**251 期紙本的負面結果也記下來**：本層在 `billboard-bn-1985h2-1987-ocr.txt.gz` 與 `cashbox-bn-1985h2-1987-ocr.txt` 裡用目錄號 `84134` 掃過，**兩刊零命中**；本盤在紙本上只以盤名出現在 Cash Box 1986-08-09 的那一段。**庫存首發不進新片評介欄、只進專欄**，是這一段的常態。
